notes.title: 6.26 Hot News! New Chapter Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40529016/9e57a3aa3bdd26de0f6baa086fdaaee4d1471ff1.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]6.26 Hot News! New Chapter Update[/b][/h2]

Dear players,
The new expansion "Chapter of the Dark Dragon" for the game, as well as the game itself, will soon be officially available on the Steam platform. We hope to receive your generous support.

On June 26, 2024, in "Wonderland M," we eagerly await your arrival, where various events and abundant rewards will be awaiting you!

Furthermore, the Wish List event is currently underway! We kindly ask for the support of all players of "Wonderland M"!

Thank you very much for your message! It sounds exciting that the new expansion "Chapter of the Dark Dragon" for "Wonderland M" is about to be officially released on the Steam platform. I will do my best to support and share this news with other players.

The Wish List event is also an interesting activity, and I encourage other players to participate and support "Wonderland M." Hopefully, this event will bring players abundant rewards and enjoyment.

Wishing the successful launch of the new expansion for "Wonderland M" and endless adventures and fun for the players!
